description: Ministry of Technology - The Personal data protection Act. No.9 of 2022, Order under Sub Section (3) of Section 1
categorisation: This gazette content focuses exclusively on the implementation timeline of the Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022. It contains a legal order specifying when different parts of the Act come into operation, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions the President's name and title, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than describing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is about legal implementation dates, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory).
